subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public TTS delivery policy that lets Telegram users choose separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that policy live in global `messages.tts` or Telegram/channel-specific config?
rationale: The source-level UX gap is clear, but the fix adds public config and overlaps with captioned-final and voice-only TTS policy, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for bundled/captioned/separate behavior before implementation.

options.title: Keep captioned delivery as direction
options.body: Reject the separate-delivery selector and document tagged/manual workarounds plus caption overflow behavior instead.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final resolves
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for the related captioned-final PR direction before deciding the config shape.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for bundled/captioned/separate behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-code routing signal is recent blame and origin/main authorship across the TTS config/schema and Telegram caption delivery files.
